title: SCORE: Environment 1
why: Environment 1's demo film (the owner's script of 2026-10-21): the app's own steps in its own windows, then one unbroken shot from the Solar System down into the Base's rooms and a walk through each of them (the default film, completed 2026-10-21: every segment names its scene, the physics animation 12 s so Earth goes nearly once round the Sun). Segments 5 and 6 wait on what is not made yet (see each one's `waiting`): the preview shows what exists in their place.

segments.why: The hub's own loop as it happened (2026-10-20): a first draw, a second, a redraw with the creator's note, then the draw he picked. The hub is picked, so its page shows the history only: the note is said in the caption, not typed again (typing it would need an unlocked place; Redraw itself spends and is never clicked).
